extracted.name: Vanilla Mug Cake
extracted.description: An easy microwave Vanilla Mug Cake (made without eggs) that's the fastest way to make dessert for one or two. Enjoy it plain or add some mix-in's!
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup +1 1/2 teaspoons all-purpose flour ((35 g))
instruction_lines: Add flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt to a mug and stir together.
Stir in milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract until smooth, being sure to scrape the bottom of the mug. Stir in sprinkles.
Cook in microwave for 70-90 seconds* (until cake is just set, but still barely shiny on top). Allow to rest in microwave for 1 minute before consuming.
